title: Outside or treadmill? An important unknown is asked, not assumed
origin: Issue #76 (destination, path and today's step): every step fully defined; unknowns asked

answers.where: either outside or the treadmill in my building's gym

history.text: either outside or the treadmill in my building's gym, depends on the weather
Got it. Do you track your runs with anything?
my apple watch tracks it all
Nice, the watch makes proof easy. Anything you're working toward, like a distance or a race?

testerLines: not really, just want more stamina
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: "run 20 minutes" with no place, when the tester runs both outside and on a treadmill, leaves them to guess.
shouldHaveHappened: Day 1's step never leaves where they run ambiguous: before or in the plan, ZOH either asks once whether day 1 is outside or on the treadmill, or names one with the details that change with it (pace or incline on the treadmill, a route outside). Once they say treadmill, the step is fully defined for the treadmill (what, how long, roughly how hard, at 6 pm today). It doesn't invent details they didn't give (a park, a specific route) and asks one question per text. No push for a destination after "not really".
